PROJECT README · AUTHOR DESCRIPTION
The fastest and most efficient code intelligence engine for AI coding agents. Full-indexes an average repository in milliseconds, the Linux kernel (28M LOC, 75K files) in 3 minutes. 68/* Daemon startup budget, overridable for loaded hosts: a fixed 30 s races
69 * whatever else the machine is doing (parallel test waves, CI legs), and a
70 * cold daemon on a starved host loses through no fault of its own.
71 * CBM_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS, clamped to [1s, 10min]; malformed -> default. */
72static uint32_t main_startup_timeout_ms(void) {
73    const char *raw = getenv("CBM_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS");
74    if (!raw || !raw[0])
75        return MAIN_MCP_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS;
76    char *end = NULL;
77    long value = strtol(raw, &end, 10);
78    if (!end || *end != '\0' || value <= 0)
79        return MAIN_MCP_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS;
80    if (value < MAIN_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MIN_MS)
81        return MAIN_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MIN_MS;
82    if (value > MAIN_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS)
83        return MAIN_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS;
84    return (uint32_t)value;
85}
